C0016.title: Sniping Attack in Auction Process Allows Attackers to Manipulate Bids
C0016.summary: A Code4rena NextGen audit finding recorded a sniping-attack issue during the auction process, stating that attackers could affect auction outcomes through bid and bid-cancellation logic. The issue illustrates risks in on-chain auctions involving automated front-running behavior, cancellation mechanisms, and manipulation of bidding results.
